node.title: You won't believe what this regular expression does!
node.author: salva
node.doctext:
Well, at least, it has surprised me: my $out = "hello\nfoo" =~ s/o*$/O/gmr; say $out hellOO fOO What is happening is that the regular expression matches the o at the end of the line, replaces it and then it matches the empty space at the end of the line and replaces it again.

But that's not what I would expect. I think that once $ is matched, Perl should continue matching in the next line.

What's your opinion?
